mcp.title: MCP permissions
mcp.description: Set the account defaults used by MCP API keys and Assistant tool calls. New accounts allow every tool and site by default.

tools.title: Allowed tools
tools.description: Turn off any tool that MCP clients and the Assistant should not be able to use.
tools.readNote: Tools that only read stored data never start crawls or lookups. They return what is already saved and say when something is missing.
